# ExpansionPanel:addLine

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.4</span></div>

Add a new line to the expansion panel.

```lua
local line = panel:addLine(label[, separator])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | yes | the line label |
| `separator` | boolean | optional (default `true`) | separator after the line |

## Returns

line (FormLine)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
panel:addLine("Label")
panel:addLine("Label", false) -- no separator
```
